items.title: Diagnose analytics configuration and launch readiness
items.summary: The authoritative snapshot shows no configured analytics coverage for vibratorporn.com, so audience, content, monetization, and health performance cannot be evaluated from telemetry. Produce a bounded read-only diagnosis of the site's registry state, analytics configuration, observable availability, monetization readiness, and required owner decisions without treating missing data as zero.

Do not change credentials, telemetry, production configuration, deployment, spending, or schedules.
